blocks.text: When trying to add "Sharepoint Online" (ID 655377) into existing SSL inspection rule, the api response is none. The cloud app catalog lists it as "Sharepoint Online" (ID 655377), but the SSL inspection API only accepts Zscaler's internal enum strings (like ONEDRIVE, ONEDRIVE_PERSONAL). This means  the correct enum for SharePoint isn't resolving.   This appears to be specific to Sharepoint Online, Dropbox for example works fine.
Upgrade to the latest version of the mcp server v0.10.5
